roadmap.title: Next: own API, same request shape

items.name: Fastino GLiDE
items.note: Same request shape on Fastino's own API, so only the base URL and key change. $0.15 per 1M input tokens.

items.name: Celeris-1 Decision
items.note: Released 8 October 2026. Implements the System One API, so only the base URL, key and model name change. Closed weights; $0.04 per 1M input tokens.

items.name: Hanzo Kai 1
items.note: Uses the same request shape as OpenRouter's Decisions API, on Hanzo's own endpoint. Closed weights; $0.021 per 1M input tokens.

items.name: meraGPT Decider 1
items.note: Hosted since 22 September 2026. Requests are capped at 4,096 tokens and 10 options per question, so Banking77 and the long Arabic datasets would fail.

items.name: Liquid AI d1-3B and d1-omni-600M
items.note: Released 7 October 2026: small open-weight versions of Liquid's d1, with GGUF builds. LFM Open License, which restricts commercial use above $10M revenue.

items.name: Kev size sweep
items.note: Apache 2.0. Kev 4B is already on the board; six more sizes from 0.5B to 27B show how one recipe scales.

items.name: Leading community open models
items.note: The top open models on the S1MB leaderboard (30 September 2026). bekko is 400M parameters; its training data overlaps the S1MB domains, so an independent test matters.

items.name: Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide and multi-Decide
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. 340M open-weight models; the multi version is multilingual.

items.name: vLLM Semantic Router d3 (Decision 3.0)
items.access: vllm-sr/d3-{edge, lite, nano, mini, flash}, vllm-sr/d3
items.note: Released 10 October 2026, superseding Decision-2.0. Apache 2.0, with GGUF builds that llama.cpp serves on /v1/systemone. Five sizes fit a 24 GB Mac; the 27B doesn't.

items.name: GLiClass Multilang
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. Small zero-shot classifier trained on 20 languages including Arabic: a cheap multilingual floor.

roadmap.title: Needs a track of its own

items.name: Respan Span-01 and Span-01 Lite
items.note: Only accepts a conversation (a list of chat messages) as the state and answers yes/no questions, so it needs a conversation track of its own.

items.name: Plain chat-model baselines
items.note: The same base models as Luna Decisions and Clef Flash, prompted for JSON. Shows what decision training adds.

items.name: Community distills
items.note: Unofficial open models trained to imitate decision models: JEV-9B, GEV-26B-Decide, the Mapika decider family and wfzyx/von. Worth a run once they have model cards and licences.

items.name: Gated, non-commercial or out-of-scope models
items.note: Surogate Rune 26B-A4B (gated weights), Torchcast Decision 27B (CC BY-NC 4.0), the fully open s1 on Gemma 4, and OpenThai-SystemOne (Thai, a language we don't test yet).

items.name: Other leaderboards
items.note: S1MB, JevBench, Decision Index and BenchLM publish decision-model results to cross-check ours against.
